_notes: An item passes only if every entry in `source` passes. Hard sources (frameDiff, blankFrame, audit:*) decide; `judge` explains or covers what can't be measured. `crop: true` sends a zoomed crop; `marks` draws numbered marks from the named audit field.

items.text: Board reads as a flat 2D map: no perspective skew, tiles edge-to-edge with no gaps
No frame where geometry vanishes, flickers or goes blank
Props rise with the terrain; nothing pops in at once; no cracks between tiles
Layered soil/stone slab edge visible under the board
No floating trees, rocks or props
Foam at waterfall crest and base; water flows downhill
Bridge arch spans the river with water visibly flowing under it
Meeples sit on their features, not floating
Every tile feature meets its edge midpoint; style matches the references
